shots.line: On November 6, 2026, a new funding report arrived in Helsinki from FinSMEs.
According to FinSMEs, Saidot has raised a new funding round of an undisclosed amount.
Based at Lapinlahdenkatu 16, Saidot was founded in 2018 by Meeri Haataja and employs 11 to 50 people.
Saidot builds an AI governance platform that maps enterprise AI agents, models, and datasets to risks and policies.
Before this undisclosed round, the company had raised 1.75 million euros in seed funding.
